Are the wastes from SMRs harder to manage?
Are the wastes from small modular reactors harder to manage?

Nuclear waste LW-SMRs, such as NuScale SMR or BWRX-300 will not be too different from conventional PWRs or BWRs. Volume for some wastes, such as low-level wastes could be higher due to higher level of radiation because of the smaller core.

Nuclear waste light-water small modular reactors, such as NuScale small modular reactor or BWRX-300 will not be too different from conventional PWRs or BWRs. Volume for some wastes, such as low-level wastes could be higher due to higher level of radiation because of the smaller core.
Wastes from non LW-SMRs will require different methods of treatment. HTGR spent fuel is an interesting example.
